messages.text: Can we implement a genuinely reliable and useful system for showing what a wallpaper would look like to people with various common types of non-standard colour vision? Are there algos for that that we can borrow from somewhere?

Write up a fully specified plan in the repo, including a carefully thought out visual/UX/UI implementation, examining the repo closely as needed for full context. Then get started on a new branch please
Please keep going, as far as you can. You have my confidence and full autonomy. Be voracious and restless. When you must wait, find other things to do.
